independence_declaration.statement: I (code-security-reviewer, session 21949e8c) authored none of the DG1 implementation, nor the round-14 repair fbc9ba6 (F-DG1-135, T-DG1-BE15, backend-workflow-engineer); fb1c151 and 985d0fa are orchestrator metadata. I raised F-DG1-135 in round 13 and verify it here as its originating reviewer. At start the real-repo HEAD was 6a3e3b2, not the freeze commit 985d0fa. 6a3e3b2 is a direct child of 985d0fa and adds only candidate-excluded metadata: round-14 assignments, the dd747fe1 manifest and stages.json. The recomputed candidate ID is dd747fe1...c559 in the real repo and in a full (not shallow) disposable clone at 985d0fa (00-candidate-identity.log). Candidate identity is the content hash, and the commit is a traceability pointer (CLAUDE.md), so I proceeded, as in rounds 11-13. During my run HEAD advanced to 2c7d1c2, the runner's auto-commit of the domain reviewer's round-14 run. I checked only its directory NAMES, and the ID is still dd747fe1 (50-cleanup.log). I formed this verdict before, and without, reading any other reviewer's round-14 record. I did not open any of them.

summary: PASS. F-DG1-135 is verified fixed and CLOSED_VERIFIED in the sidecar. TEST_FILE = /\.test\.tsx?$/ (architecture.testkit.ts:183) now equals the tsconfig.build.json test excludes. A planted zz.test.mts gets the full boundary rules (flagged for ../../modules.ts and vitest), while zz.test.ts keeps the test exemption. The real tree has 0 violations, and architecture.test.ts passes 128/128. All required checks ran: typecheck, build, lint, openapi, no-cdn and format pass; unit tests pass 321/321 on Node 22 and 24; gates/agents tests pass 105/105 and deploy tests 59/59; SBOM OK; DG0 historical PASS; the three ci.yml copies are identical. The integration suite (200/200 tests) passed in runs 2 and 3 and on Node 24. Run 1 exited 1 on an afterAll hookTimeout under heavy host contention, raised as new Low, non-mandatory finding F-DG1-136. AC-1 (effect) and the registry install are BLOCKED (no network). The only source delta is the testkit plus its test, so there is no security regression, and there are no unresolved Critical, High or mandatory findings in my scope.
